result.instructions: Tools for Barion, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What balance does each of my Barion accounts hold?"; "Show my Barion wallet transactions from today."; "Give me the details of the last Barion payment that came in.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Barion data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run barion_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run barion_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run barion_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. barion_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: barion_list_accounts
tools.title: List wallet accounts
tools.description: List the currency accounts in the Barion wallet of the key's owner, with their balances. Barion: GET /v2/Accounts.

tools.name: barion_list_history
tools.title: List wallet transaction history
tools.description: List wallet transaction history items, newest first, up to 20 per call. Page by passing the last item's Id as lastVisibleItemId: only older items come back. Not for reconciliation: use barion_list_accounts and the statement download in Barion for that. Barion: GET /v3/UserHistory/GetHistory.

lastVisibleItemId.description: Id of the oldest item already seen. Only older items are returned.

lastRequestTime.description: UTC ISO 8601 time. Only items at or after this time are returned.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. HUF or EUR. Omit for all currencies.

tools.name: barion_get_history_item
tools.title: Get wallet transaction details
tools.description: Get the full details of one wallet history item (payment, fee, transfer, withdrawal, refund or top-up), by the item Id from barion_list_history. Barion: GET /v3/TransactionHistory/GetDetail.

itemId.description: Id of the history item, from barion_list_history.
